rows.label: tlk46500173_01_msg0001
rows.name: I'd like to say welcome, but...

rows.label: tlk46500173_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm afraid we only do business
with salvagers of Rank D or
higher at this establishment.

rows.label: tlk46500173_01_msg0003
rows.name:
If you don't even know about Salvager
Ranks, this isn't the place for you.
Come back after starting from scratch.

rows.label: tlk46500173_01_msg0102
rows.name:
Always happy to do business
with a trusted salvager.
